messages:
zoe: hey team :wave: just unboxed my MacBook Air M2 and trying to enroll in MDM. Enrollment failed with a 'Profile installation failed' popup after I connected to the Wi-Fi captive portal. anyone seen this?

it-bot: Device enrollment request received for zoe. device id: device-1771000456. Status: pending.

itops: hey zoe — welcome! quick q: which Wi‑Fi network did you join? Redwood-Secure or Redwood-Guest?

zoe: i joined Redwood-Secure (the normal WPA2 one) and put in my SSO creds. after that safari redirected to a captive portal, then the MDM profile installer popped and failed.

sam: hii. sometimes the captive portal interrupt breaks the profile flow. two quick workarounds: 1) try again but open https://enroll.redwood-internal.example/ in Safari before the profile installer runs. 2) if still broken, create a hotspot from your phone, join it, and re-run enrollment.

eli: extra data point — on macOS 13/14 the Profiles pane moved. go to System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Profiles (or search 'profiles' in settings) and see if the 'Redwood MDM' profile is listed partially installed. can you paste the exact error text?

zoe: error box said: 'Profile installation failed. An error occurred installing the profile. (MDM_ENROLLMENT_ERROR: ENROLL-403)'. copied logs from installer window.

itops: ENROLL-403 usually means an enrollment token mismatch or the device saw the captive portal cert and canceled. can you try Sam's hotspot trick first? if that works we'll re-run the token.

zoe: tried hotspot -> enrollment screen loaded, then it asked to allow the profile in Settings -> Privacy & Security, i clicked 'Allow' but then it hung and eventually said 'installation timed out'.

sam: ok, next step: open Terminal and run this to push the profiles agent log to us (will help debug):

```bash
log show --predicate 'subsystem == "com.apple.ManagedClient"' --last 1h > ~/mdm-log.txt
```

then attach the file here or DM to @itops. DO NOT paste credentials.

zoe: dropping the log now, attached as mdm-log.txt (sanitized).

eli: thanks. I see the sequence: captive portal -> profile install attempted -> TLS cert check failed -> token mismatch. i'll reissue a one-time enroll token for you and DM it.

maya: welcome again! when this is done pls post here if you need sudo/admin for Homebrew etc. we give sudo temporarily until devtools are installed then revoke.

itops: quick note on FileVault: our MDM enforces FileVault. if enrollment fails FileVault may not be enabled. we won't force-enable remotely until the device is properly enrolled. if you want to enable it manually you can, but please wait for us if you're not comfortable. command (macOS):

```bash
sudo fdesetup status
# to enable (requires a recovery key config in MDM): sudo fdesetup enable
```

zoe: appreciate it. i don't want to mess with FileVault if MDM will manage the key. please proceed with the one-time token.

sam: token DM sent. instructions: join phone hotspot, open Safari to https://enroll.redwood-internal.example/ , paste the token when prompted, then accept profiles in Settings. give it ~2 minutes after accept.

zoe: followed that and it says 'Enrollment successful' :tada:. Profiles show Redwood MDM and FileVault policies pending.

it-bot: Enrollment completed for device-1771000456. Profile: Redwood MDM. FileVault policy applied: pending.

eli: nice. i'll kick the FileVault enable from backend so the device gets the recovery key automatically. give it ~5m and then verify with `sudo fdesetup status`.

zoe: fdesetup status now shows 'FileVault is On.' thanks! one last q — do i get admin rights to install dev tools?

maya: yes, temporary admin for the first week. sam will add you to the brew/admin group.

sam: added you to the 'dev-install' admin group. you should be able to `brew install` and run Docker. if anything fails ping me and i'll remote in.

zoe: confirmed i can install Homebrew, thanks everyone :heart: super smooth onboarding so far.

itops: leaving one note: if anyone else hits captive portal -> profile issues, try the hotspot workaround or pre-open the enroll URL in Safari. we'll also add a troubleshooting snippet to the new-hires onboarding doc.

sam: filing a tiny doc update task in the onboarding checklist (assigning to devex).

maya: congrats and welcome again :confetti_ball:
